scope_tr: Eruh Barajı ve HES Projesi FERNAS Enerji Elektrik Üretim A.Ş.‘ye Yap-İşlet modeli ile verilmiştir. body_html_en:
Eruh Dam and HPP Project has been given by built-operate and transfer to NAS INC. As part of the project;  with full dam building, project has electromechanic  turbine with 44,00 MW power also  it has supply and montage of generator (engineering, supply of material, building, montage, test and start-up works) ( Built-Operate)

Scope of Work: Fernas-4 SPP project will be done as built-operate and transfer and it will have 20 MW installed power. As a part of Project  engineering, supply of material, montage and start up  works will be done.
